title: agentgw shared definitions
description: Types reused by more than one agentgw schema. Not a document schema; has no example. Version 1.

version.description: Schema version of this document. Every breaking change bumps it.

money.description: An amount of money as an integer count of micro-units (1/1,000,000 of the currency unit). 5000 USD micros = $0.005. Never a float.

window.description: Budget window. per_run is keyed by run_id; daily and monthly roll over at 00:00 UTC.

ed25519_pubkey_hex.description: Lower-case hex of a 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

ed25519_sig_hex.description: Lower-case hex of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

principal.description: Who is calling. agent_id and owner come from gateway config; run_id is one gateway process (or --run flag); session_id is the MCP session.

owner.description: Human or team responsible for the agent. Free-form, e.g. an email.

server_name.description: Upstream name from gateway config. No dots, so '<server>.<tool>' splits on the first dot.

approval_spec.description: How to obtain approval when outcome is require_approval.

approvers.description: Identities allowed to decide, as reported by the surface doing the approving (GitHub comments: the GitHub login, case-insensitive; no prefix syntax). An entry that is not a valid identity on a surface never matches there, so that surface fails closed. Empty means any approver who passes the surface's own checks. The terminal does not enforce the list. Rev 10, gap-008, docs/adr/0011 decision 8.

grant.description: A standing approval: calls matching (agent_id, [run_id], server, tool) before `until` are allowed without prompting. scope=run grants carry the run_id and die with the run; scope=agent grants apply to every run of the agent until `until`.

approval_id.description: The approval that issued this grant.

run_id.description: Required when scope is run; empty otherwise.

tool.description: Exact tool name, not a glob.

approval_decision.description: A human's decision on one approval. Bound to the exact call id and args hash. approver_sig is the Ed25519 signature (hex) by the approver's token over the JCS (RFC 8785) bytes of {"approval_id","args_hash","decision","ts"} where ts is the RFC 3339 UTC string below. Empty when the surface has no key (e.g. Slack), in which case approver_id is the surface's user id.

approver_id.description: Hex Ed25519 public key of a CLI approver token, or a surface-specific user id.

reason.description: Free text from the approver. Empty when none.

grant.description: Grant issued with an approval, or null.

via.description: Optional (rev 9, docs/adr/0011): the surface and human behind a decision signed by a key the gateway holds (GitHub comments). Absent for CLI decisions. Not covered by approver_sig; attested only by the entry's sig, so it records what the gateway saw, not who holds the approver key.

user.description: The surface's user id: the GitHub login.

url.description: Where the decision can be checked independently: the comment's html_url.
